purpose: Independent mechanism-level migration audit for DATE Accept; no EDA, GPU, remote execution, or new performance claims.
decision_reason: Every relevant open-source mechanism is already represented by C1/M528-M533, C2/M519, or C3/M518; has failed a fair H67 trace such as M484/M482 or an existing G/H NO-GO; or lacks the mathematical precondition required by H67 ATLIF-PSN.

migration_rows.source_mechanism: subset/prefix product sparsity, stable popcount/index dispatch, residual completion, double-buffered preprocessing
migration_rows.h67_delta: exact signed parent/residual with a 64-row directory, 240 KiB envelope, 144 B single-port 1RW parent scratch, dead-only writes, and atomic completion
migration_rows.one_day_gate: Run only the already released exact-SHA M533 VCS after resource collision clears; require zero reference mismatch and all SVA/attack/coverage conditions. Macro-inclusive physical accounting remains subsequent work.

migration_rows.source_mechanism: L1 pattern/PWP plus exact signed L2 residual; PAFT as a separate lossy mode
migration_rows.h67_delta: parent/PWP-like exact reuse plus signed correction terminating in Acc24; PAFT must remain a separately identified checkpoint Pareto
migration_rows.one_day_gate: Paired M579 replay with identical capacity, ports, and trace; exact must be zero mismatch. Lossy admission additionally requires full-sequence disclosure, delta AEE <= 0.02, and local incremental cycle gain >= 1.15x.

migration_rows.source_mechanism: L2 row packing, compact packs, PWP prefetch, reconfigurable adder tree
migration_rows.h67_delta: typed signed descriptors released K8 at a time into one shared Acc24 state; PWP prefetch is not directly applicable because M528 does not store PWP payload
migration_rows.one_day_gate: Complete matched M519 DC for K8 versus equal-total-bandwidth K1x8; require >= 1.15x throughput/mm2 or energy/source benefit. Tag elision remains subordinate to physical evidence.

migration_rows.source_mechanism: multi-lane bitmap decoding, wide-bank broadcast, extra-worker out-of-order load balance
migration_rows.h67_delta: K8 signed magnitude/tag/time/terminal source release under identical eight-bank bandwidth and one shared Acc24; the fair baseline is K1x8
migration_rows.one_day_gate: Matched M519 DC and frozen-trace comparison against K1x8 for frequency, area, sequential cells, throughput/mm2, and energy. Do not reopen M482 FC1.

migration_rows.source_mechanism: implicit transpose through SRAM bank/address/byte layout and QK/V overlap with QKV projection
migration_rows.h67_delta: potential RQTB/attention address-layout optimization only if an explicit transpose bottleneck exists in H67
migration_rows.one_day_gate: Read-only address-trace audit must find >= 30 percent dedicated transpose traffic/stall or >= 1.20x local same-port gain before any RTL.

migration_rows.source_mechanism: explicit RST/UPDATE/FIRE events, resident double-buffered neuron state, time-of-last-update lazy leak
migration_rows.h67_delta: typed events and resident state are relevant, but H67 ATLIFTernaryPSN is a dense or factorized temporal matrix followed by thresholding rather than scalar recurrent LIF
migration_rows.one_day_gate: Require an exact H67 PSN recurrence equivalence, CPU zero mismatch, and >= 1.15x local same-resource gain. The mathematical precondition currently fails.

migration_rows.source_mechanism: bundled AER, mini-batch spiking Gustavson, single membrane-row read/write, spine/token elastic pipeline
migration_rows.h67_delta: row-coherent signed bundles for dense optical flow, which lacks first-correct classification response semantics
migration_rows.one_day_gate: Gate already failed: M484 reports 1.0x same-resource cycles and slightly worse traffic. Do not rerun or implement new RTL.

allowed_closeout_priority.scope: existing exact-SHA VCS then macro-inclusive scratch accounting
matched K8/K1/K1x8 DC, throughput-per-area, and energy closeout
matched Fixed/rank-3 DC and checkpoint/accuracy identity closeout

limitations: No new replay was run against a Phi official code artifact; only the paper mechanism was audited.
FireFly-T and ELSA were audited from public preprint versions and should be rechecked against final versions before submission.
No macro, CACTI, Synopsys, GPU, or remote measurement was performed in this audit.
Local performance values are cited from existing sealed evidence and are not newly generated by M589.
